news.title: OpenAI updates its Agents SDK to help enterprises build safer, more capable agents
news.description: OpenAI has expanded the capabilities of its agent-building toolkit, as agentic AI continues to grow in popularity.

news.title: Hightouch reaches $100M ARR fueled by marketing tools powered by AI
news.description: The startup says it grew its ARR by $70 million in just 20 months after launching an AI agent platform for marketers.

news.title: LinkedIn data shows AI isn’t to blame for hiring decline… yet
news.description: LinkedIn says hiring is down 20% since 2022, but blames higher interest rates — not AI — for the slowdown.

news.title: AI learning app Gizmo levels up with 13M users and a $22M investment
news.description: Gizmo, an AI-powered learning platform, has attracted more than 13 million users and just secured $22 million in Series A funding.

news.title: Snapchat owner cuts 1,000 jobs as says AI will reduce repetitive work
news.description: The Snapchat owner is laying off around 16% of staff and withdrawn hundreds of open job roles.

news.title: AI Could Democratize One of Tech's Most Valuable Resources
news.description: AI is making it easier to design chips and optimize software for different silicon. Some startups envision a revolution in chipmaking.

news.title: Allbirds Is Pivoting to AI Compute. Sure, Why Not
news.description: Once a $4 billion apparel juggernaut, Allbirds will rebrand as NewBird AI, a “GPU-as-a-Service” company. Hey, if you can't beat ’em, join ’em.

news.title: AI Slop Is Making the Internet Fake-Happy
news.description: A new study examines the impact of the rise of AI-generated websites on the internet—and found some surprising results.
